To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
gadolinia-dope ceria interlayers prepared by a spray pyrolytic method can be used to improve the performance of solid oxide fuel cell with vacuum plasma-spraying electrolyte.
the gadolinia-dopped ceria thin films between the electrolyte and the cathode of the solid oxide fuel cells improved the power output of the cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of SOFCs with improved power output by the use of thin CGO interlayers.
a new approach for preparing SOFC electrolyte interlayers by a simple and cost effective method.
the optimization of the electrolyte–interlayer–cathode stack for vacuum plasma spraying of SOFC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
spray-pyrolysis is a promising method to deposit interlayers between vacuum plasma-spray deposited YSZ electrolytes and LSM cathodes.
the CGO interlayer improves the performance of cells by more than 30%, and that the CGOs are more suitable as electrolyte–catalyst interlayers in vacuum plasma-spraying than YSZ.
the use of CGO as a thin film electrolyte interlayer between 8YSZ–YPS electrolytes and screen-printed LSM cathodes is an effective way to increase the power density of SOFCs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
spray pyrolyzed CGO thin films improve the performance of vacuum plasma-sprays 8YSZ–YSZ cells.
the use of CGO as an electrolyte interlayer in SOFCs with plasma-sprayed YSZ electrolytes is promising for the development of low-cost and high-power SOFCs.
CGO interlayers between the plasma-sprayed YSZ electrolytes and the LSM cathodes increase the power output of the cells by 20% compared with cells without interlayers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spray pyrolytic deposition of interlayers between the electrolyte and the cathode can be an alternative to conventional screen-printing of interlayers.
spray pyrolyzed CGO interlayers are promising candidates for SOFCs fabricated by vacuum plasma spraying.
the spray pyrolysed interlayers have a significant effect on the performance of SOFC.
